title: Tailwind CSS in Next.js
description: Set up the popular utility‑first framework and build a responsive page in minutes.

slides.title: What is Tailwind CSS? 🌪️
slides.content:
# Utility‑First CSS Framework

Instead of writing custom CSS, you combine small utility classes directly in your JSX.

```html
<button class="bg-blue-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded hover:bg-blue-600">
  Click me
</button>
```

* Fast prototyping.
* Consistent design system.
* Responsive and dark mode out of the box.
* PurgeCSS removes unused styles automatically in production.

Next.js makes setup incredibly easy with the Tailwind CLI.

slides.title: Setup with create-next-app (Terminal)
slides.content: When creating a new project, simply choose Tailwind. Or add it manually.

quizData.question: Which Tailwind class would you use to set a red background?
quizData.explanation: Tailwind uses `bg-{color}-{shade}` for background colors. The shade ranges from 50 (light) to 900 (dark).

slides.title: Pro Tip ✨
slides.content: Tailwind can be combined with CSS Modules if needed. For repeated component styles, extract them using the `@apply` directive in a `@layer components` block inside your global CSS.
